query:
SELECT id, storage_path FROM playground_assets WHERE COALESCE(last_used_at, created_at) < '2026-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT id FROM media WHERE media.local_asset_id = playground_assets.id) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM context_messages cm,
      json_each(cm.payload_json, '$.details.mcpImages.items') image
    WHERE json_extract(image.value, '$.assetId') = playground_assets.id
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tool_calls tc,
      json_each(tc.result_content_json, '$.details.mcpImages.items') image
    WHERE json_extract(image.value, '$.assetId') = playground_assets.id
  )
